marca.estilo_visual: ultra-clean 3D render in the style of Octane and Unreal Engine, soft cinematic lighting, modern minimalist psychology office, deep red (#E24B4A) accents, cream (#FAF6F1) tones, premium editorial advertising aesthetic, no neon, no cyberpunk, no oversaturation. The Marli mascot 'Li' is a friendly HUMANOID robot with a glossy deep red and white body, a rounded-square head that is a black screen displaying a simple white pixel smiley face (two dot eyes and a curved smile), and a silver chest plate reading 'MARLI'
